name: folder-tree
title: Folder Tree
description: A Notion-style navigation tree for a file library — sections of folders, pages and files; folders that load their children on first open with loading, error, empty and Show all rows; one tab stop with tree arrow keys and typeahead; a ⋯ menu per row; pointer drag into a folder or section; and a folders-only picker mode for Move dialogs.

meta.whenToUse: The navigation pane of a file library or knowledge base — folders, pages and files in sections, with lazy folders, row menus and drag to move; and, in picker mode, the folder list of a Move dialog.
meta.whenNotToUse: App navigation with fixed links (Sidebar), a flat list of files (AttachmentGroup layout="list" or DataList), or a nested filter editor (FilterBuilder).
